notes.title: Release 157: PORTALS!
notes.content:
This update is accessible via the "Live" release of Boundless on Steam.

Please [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-157-report-issues-here/6591]report all issues discovered with the update to this support thread[/url].

Please restart Steam to make sure you get the latest version of Boundless. If the update happens whilst Steam is open it's unlikely you'll get the latest version.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/6c3ca19d7287f4a8883d1d1908edd6311a5d3af3.jpg[/img]

[b]Release: 157[/b]
[list]
[*]Art + Animation + Assets:
[list]
[*]Updated 3rd person tool animations for the shovel, chisel and axe.
[/list]
[*]Crafting + Resources + Equipment:
[list]
[*]Added portals:
[list]
[*]Craft portal conduit blocks and place them into a rectangle shape to interact. Noting portal blocks may only be placed inside a beacon.
[*]Craft a portal token from a completed portal and insert it into another portal of the same shape.
[*]Insert sufficient Oort shards to power the portal and press to open.
[*]If the portal token is invalid or the destination is already open, the portal connection will fail and you will not be charged.
[*]Once opened the portal behaves much like a warp, with both sides of the portal connection going into a loading state, and then into a smashing state that will go into a dormant state if not smashed open.
[*]Once a portal is fully open, it will be powered by the original source activation side, and display how much time is remaining and allows more oort shards to be added to continue fueling the portal after opening.
[*]The portal can be re-activated once dormant, and can be smashed open, and can be closed from both sides, but only the source side of the portal will be used for fueling of an active portal pair.
[*]The larger the portal, the further it can travel, with costs determined purely by the size of the portal.
[/list]
[*]Fixed an issue where flowers could not be mined correctly.
[*]Recipes and Drops
[list]
[*]Craft Portal Conduit in the Workbench
[*]Rough Oort Stone are dropped from Roadrunners, and high level Spitters and Cuttletrunks.
[*]Oort Shards can be extracted from Rough Oort Stone.
[/list]
[*]Refined warp behaviours so that warps will always open up at a "safe" location (not in mid-air, not in lava, not deep underwater, not inside someone else's beacon) even without bumping the warp manually. And adjusted permissions so that it is the user that activates, bumps, or re-activates (in the case of a dormant warp) the warp, whose beacon permissions are considered. - Changed the order that machines blocks reveal as, so they look better as a stack.
[*]Flowers now have proper 3D meshes.
[/list]
[*]Creatures + Combat:
[list]
[*]Changed scale on Roadrunners so there is less variation.
[*]Changed debug info relating to bandwidth to display bit rates to allow easier comparison to ISP quoted speed rates, speed testers etc (kibibit and mebibit display to be explicit). Also added display of the current chunk rate limit.
[*]Cuttletrunk now uses steering system to navigate around inside caves.
[*]Fix for Cuttletrunk diving into the floor when near cliffs.
[/list]
[*]GUI + HUD:
[list]
[*]Added systems to gather information about friends, whether they're online, what world they were last recorded on, and if they're online, where are they approximately displayed in the GUI.
[*]Allow warps to be opened to an online friend with costs determined as usual by world distances.
[*]Fixed an issue where the region select screen was not shown to new players.
[*]Fixed pickup effect not disappearing for players with uppercase characters in their username.
[*]Reduce the amount of network data the compass system was sending.
[*]Users now have a 'home location' which will be initially set when you enter the server for the first time, and will then be updated when you first place a beacon control. From that point on you can update the home location whenever stood in a beacon you have permissions for from the locations tab of the player GUI. Home locations are just as expensive to create a warp to, but will allow you to open the warp even if you don't have enough coin by allowing you to go negative so that you should never be completely stuck.
[/list]
[*]SFX + Music:
[list]
[*]Fix some missing creature audio.
[/list]
[*]Engine:
[list]
[*]Fixed server/client crash when pickups spawn in water.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Resolved Known Issues:[/b]

[i]The following items were known issues in previous releases and have now been resolved.[/i]
[list]
[*]'Workbench Construction' achievement not triggered after completion.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]

[i]The following items are known issues in this release.[/i]
[list]
[*]Assigning both mouse buttons to 'Use Left Hand Option' will disable the left mouse button.
[*]Buying plinths that had wanted items set before v151 have unset them. Sorry. Going forward they will be fine.
[*][b][new][/b] Cannot click left arrow on various game options.
[*][b][new][/b] Cannot close Inventory when Chat is used.
[*][b][new][/b] Cannot sell some items even if the tint matches on a Buying Plinth.
[*]Chat text overlaps with HUD Text in the centre of the screen.
[*]Entity rendering will not always work correctly when there are multiple warps very close together, or where a warp opens up to a location very near where the entrance is.
[*]Gem grappling hooks retract automatically when hanging.
[*][b][new][/b] Item placed into buying plinth will disappear when placing the same item into storage.
[*][b][new][/b] Item wanted is completely different to what was placed there before on the buying plinth.
[*]Opening or closing doors and trapdoors when standing too close to them will restrict player movement. To get out of the situation, interact with the door or trapdoor again.
[*][b][new][/b] Portal UI text overflows when the portal token name is very long.
[*]Shift-clicking an item from the selling plinth will show odd numbers and will not always go in the shopping basket.
[*]Shift-clicking and dragging on the coin icons from within the trading menus may cause a crash.
[*][b][new][/b] Smart stack icon does not have the same tint as the items within the smart stack itself.
[*]Some Extractor machines lack animation.
[*]Some interactive blocks (crafting table, machine, beacon control) have become corrupted during the migration. This will result in at best those blocks not being able to be interacted with, at worst the game crashing when interacting with those blocks. To fix the issue the block(s) in question need to be re-placed. In the case of anything other than a beacon control the block can simply be broken, picked up, and then re-placed. In the case of a beacon control this will work, although it would result in all the plots having to be re-placed one at a time and during that process the contents being unprotected. A better workaround for a beacon control is to craft a new beacon control, place that, and then break the old one, which will keep the beacon's plots placed throughout the process.
[*]Some menu options are cut off at the top and bottom.
[*][b][new][/b] Speech bubbles may still be displayed above players after going through portals.
[*]The recipes are not final.
[*]Z-fighting with some items (workbench and other machines) when placed underwater.
[/list]
[i]Cross posted from [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-157-portals/6590]devlog forum

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update: 2017 February 24th - Warp to friends and PORTALS!
notes.content:
This week we [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-156-hud-creatures-ai-and-butchering/6519]updated the game[/url] to include slightly smarter creatures and displaying location markers on remote planets in the HUD.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/293ac18eb367e10bcb02c688067cf0455a7651d3.jpg[/img]

We have finished working on allowing players to build their own portals. The code is in the current release but we have yet to enable it as we did not have the time to do sufficient internal testing. We need to choose the recipe for Oort Shards that powers the portal.

[strike]Next[/strike] this week, we hope to release the following:
[list]
[*]Warping to friends.
[*]Updated creature presentation in compass.
[*]Updated character animation for some of the tools. E.g. the shovel.
[*]Further improvements to the HUD.
[*]Additional moves and AI for the Cuttletrunk.
[*]Possibly additional VFX and SFX added.
[/list]
We have started to reskin the User Interface to reflect our final design. You will start to see changes to UI such as the inventory screen by mid March.

[b]Code[/b]
The portal code is now in and being tested so, all being well, will be in the next release.
The new creature drop system was completed. The creatures pathing have been improved again, now able to get through one block wide gaps. We have also resolved why some creature audio was not playing so there will be more SFX in the next version.

The GUI skinning is being worked through, with the inventory being updated. The additional planet HUD information is being implemented. The user can now see which planet friends are on and where to allow them to warp to them.

The damage system is being overhauled to use attribute system, so flaming or corrupted hammers etc will deal different kinds of damage.

We’ve also worked on an demo version of the game for an upcoming event and resolving a number of bugs that showed up.

Further work on was done on the Sony TRCs, such as the Trophies back end. The database testing continued and ironed out a few back end issues.

[b]Design[/b]
Ollie has been working on an idea to score builds based on the resources used. It wouldn’t be able to judge how awesome things look, but providing some sense of progression based on how much time, energy and / or Coin has gone into the blocks and props will give builders a sense of satisfaction. He’s also looked into how villages, towns and cities are identified and marked on the worlds. Around that there’s been lots more work to do on attributes data for characters, creatures and items.

Rob has been working on the character information and skill tree GUI.

Luke Has been working on an expanded Sanctum to include character creation, account creation and teach new players the basics of Boundless.

[b]Art[/b]
The art team has been busy on the first character race modelling, VFX and 3rd person animations.

We’ve also been working on a list of earth-like prefabs for our worlds for V1.0.

Jess rebuilt a new head template in preparation of new face designs and new head shapes. Here she’s matching our current head shapes to the new template:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/938d6ac80895bd5d778eee9517565399e5ce2ca2.jpg[/img]

This image shows the two body sizes and shapes available for our race.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/52b864292b79f79911d3caf13eb62d9ab68f515b.jpg[/img]

The more slender character body mesh. The slender character is also scaled smaller in game:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/6e7622dbf9e4cc92c05a5a96dc902085b4629e0c.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/4d542ef5471e3e2c7bcf91e523ff092400d277c0.jpg[/img]

Last but not least, here’s the first of our new faces. 
We’re very excited to be working on these.
This is an ‘elf’ face sculpt:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/3c48ea4188ccf5959124700f7b7c7cd5c13cfad4.jpg[/img]

Gerry has been working on the 3rd person tool animations. The shovel animation should be in [strike]next[/strike] this week’s release.

Code (Michael and Luca) have also provided us with a neat system that scales the 1st person tools and weapons to compensate for changes in screen aspect ratio. This means the tools/weapons are now centralised so we can go ahead and author the final 1st person animations and prototype the lance.

Dom has completed all the elemental point effects for impacts. Here’s a sneak peek of the corrosion version:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/9f68987838348966b7b02b6b5f5b88b4f776eb5f.gif[/img]

[i]Cross posted from [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/weekly-dev-update-2017-february-24th-warp-to-friends-and-portals/6570]devlog forum

It wouldn’t be able to judge how awesome things look, but providing some sense of progression based on how much time, energy and / or Coin has gone into the blocks and props will give builders a sense of satisfaction. He’s also looked into how villages, towns and cities are identified and marked on the worlds. Around that there’s been lots more work to do on attributes data for characters, creatures and items.

Rob has been working on the character information and skill tree GUI.

Luke Has been working on an expanded Sanctum to include character creation, account creation and teach new players the basics of Boundless.

[b]Art[/b]
The art team has been busy on the first character race modelling, VFX and 3rd person animations.

We’ve also been working on a list of earth-like prefabs for our worlds for V1.0.

Jess rebuilt a new head template in preparation of new face designs and new head shapes. Here she’s matching our current head shapes to the new template:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/52b864292b79f79911d3caf13eb62d9ab68f515b.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/6e7622dbf9e4cc92c05a5a96dc902085b4629e0c.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/4d542ef5471e3e2c7bcf91e523ff092400d277c0.jpg[/img]

Last but not least, here’s the first of our new faces. 
We’re very excited to be working on these.
This is an ‘elf’ face sculpt:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/3c48ea4188ccf5959124700f7b7c7cd5c13cfad4.jpg[/img]

Gerry has been working on the 3rd person tool animations. The shovel animation should be in [strike]next[/strike] this week’s release.

Code (Michael and Luca) have also provided us with a neat system that scales the 1st person tools and weapons to compensate for changes in screen aspect ratio. This means the tools/weapons are now centralised so we can go ahead and author the final 1st person animations and prototype the lance.

Dom has completed all the elemental point effects for impacts. Here’s a sneak peek of the corrosion version:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/9f68987838348966b7b02b6b5f5b88b4f776eb5f.gif[/img]

notes.title: Release 156: HUD, Creatures AI and Butchering!
notes.content:
[b]This update is accessible via the "Live" release of Boundless on Steam.[/b]

Please [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-156-report-issues-here/6520]report all issues discovered with the update to this support thread[/url].

Please restart Steam to make sure you get the latest version of Boundless. If the update happens whilst Steam is open it's unlikely you'll get the latest version.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/5a693823a8a0de18683c7a3ee396dd71c19dc2fc.jpg[/img]

[b]Release Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Creatures + Combat:
[list]
[*]Added AI steering system:
[list]
[*]Creatures will now attempt to walk around an obstacle rather than straight at it.
[*]Creatures are far less likely to fall off cliffs.
[/list]
[*]Creatures are now more likely to try and jump onto sloped blocks.
[*]Creatures drop shadow is now underneath them when they die.
[*]Creatures now drop items when the corpse is hit.
[list]
[*]Multiple players can hit the same creature to get their drops.
[*]Creatures will now always drop at least one item.
[*]A particle effect is played to show if the creature has any drops to collect.
[/list]
[*]Fix fall animation not triggering when cuttletrunk dies.
[*]Increased target break range on spitter and wildstock to 30m.
[/list]
[*]GUI + HUD:
[list]
[*]Added damage numbers when the creatures are hit.
[*]Added "Use tool to break blocks to open warp" hint to tell players how to open warps.
[*]Clamp first person item positions for really wide screen aspect ratio, e.g. 21:9.
[*]Fix not consuming the mouse down event when clicking to regain focus.
[*]Fix crash caused by holding down the left mouse button and scrolling the mouse wheel at the same time.
[*]Fix crash caused by interaction with plinths when Interface Scale was set to Large.
[*]Fix issue where damage information appears twice caused by exploding hoppers.
[*]GUI menu optimisations for changing tabs and wobble
[*]Planet markers are rendered on the planets showing your stored locations when the players aim them with the totem tool.
[*]Updated region compass information:
[list]
[*]It shows ??? if the closest region has not been discovered yet.
[*]The direction displayed takes the region as the reference. (North of X, means that the player has to go south to find the region X)
[*]Changed EAST SOUTH to SOUTHEAST etc.
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Engine:
[list]
[*]Added code to ask AMD to select the high performance GPU in Intel + AMD GPU setups.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]

[i]The following items are known issues in this release.[/i]
[list]
[*][new] Assigning both mouse buttons to 'Use Left Hand Option' will disable the left mouse button.
[*][new] Attacking corpses of smaller Wildstock with a Totem may occasionally cause a crash.
[*]Buying plinths that had wanted items set before v151 have unset them. Sorry. Going forward they will be fine.
[*]Chat text overlaps with HUD Text in the centre of the screen.
[*]Entity rendering will not always work correctly when there are multiple warps very close together, or where a warp opens up to a location very near where the entrance is.
[*]Gem grappling hooks retract automatically when hanging.
[*]Opening or closing doors and trapdoors when standing too close to them will restrict player movement. To get out of the situation, interact with the door or trapdoor again.
[*]Shift-clicking an item from the selling plinth will show odd numbers and will not always go in the shopping basket.
[*]Shift-clicking and dragging on the coin icons from within the trading menus may cause a crash.
[*]Some Extractor machines lack animation.
[*]Some interactive blocks (crafting table, machine, beacon control) have become corrupted during the migration. This will result in at best those blocks not being able to be interacted with, at worst the game crashing when interacting with those blocks. To fix the issue the block(s) in question need to be re-placed. In the case of anything other than a beacon control the block can simply be broken, picked up, and then re-placed. In the case of a beacon control this will work, although it would result in all the plots having to be re-placed one at a time and during that process the contents being unprotected. A better workaround for a beacon control is to craft a new beacon control, place that, and then break the old one, which will keep the beacon's plots placed throughout the process.
[*][new] Some menu options are cut off at the top and bottom.
[*]The recipes are not final.
[*][new] 'Workbench Construction' achievement not triggered after completion.
[*]Z-fighting with some items (workbench and other machines) when placed underwater.
[/list]
[i]Portals coming in Release 157 next week.[/i]

[b]Release 156.1[/b]

[b]Resolved Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Attacking corpses of smaller Wildstock with a Totem may occasionally cause a crash.
[/list]
[i]Cross posted from [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-156-hud-creatures-ai-and-butchering/6519]devlog forum

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update: 2017 February 17th - Portals, Character Customisation and Flowers
notes.content:
There were no Live or Testing updates for Boundless this week. But we have been busy. The following features will be coming in the next release:
[list]
[*]GUI rendering, update and animation optimisations to increase game performance.
[*]Tweaks to the Player damage indicator in the HUD.
[*]Improved Creature AI, including creatures not falling off cliffs, avoiding obstacles and searching for routes to track you.
[*]Early version of Location Markers on Planets in the HUD.
[*]If we are lucky, we might be able to release the new portal! Wish us luck.
[/list]
The foundation work on the unified Attributes / Stats / Progression System is almost done. This will allow the designers to easily modify game balance across Creatures, Tools, Weapons, Buffs, Bombs and Player Progression.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/2388858afd9e69a80bdf1834b813f0740ef8a8e4.jpg[/img]

Thank you to all the YouTubers posting their Boundless videos. We have been learning lots and our designers have been making changes to the game including the tutorial / objectives to make the game flow smoother and more intuitive. The new users will see these changes soon.

[b]Code[/b]
Portals are in the last stage of the implementation and being tested to shake out functionality and usability issues. Portals can be created between and within Worlds. Opening and maintaining an open portal both cost resources. Currently this is balanced to make it much more resource efficient to maintain open portals.

A new creature drop system has being implemented where you have to hit a dead creature to extract and collect the drops. Each player can extract and collect their own drops. The creature will still de-spawn after a fixed time. This system stops vulture players from stealing drops, and also makes the drops easier to find especially if a creature was killed from range. The perceived down side of players getting drops for free is IMO offset by removing the option for griefing by stealing another player's drops. Also drop stalking players still need to survive in the environment where the drops are appearing.

The attribute system is being worked on, with the health system being the first system to be updated. The damage, explosion and impact feedback is being hooked up and will be updated to support the new damage types. This includes elemental and physical properties.

The HUD will now displayer a player's location markers on remote planets when they're holding the Totem. This includes your own markers, friends beacons, your guilds locations, cities and the capital.

We’ve been fixing up a number of GUI issues for the next release. We also spent time investigating issues for the corrupted GUI and controller lag people have been reporting. Additionally we also worked on the PlayStation 4 TRC.

[b]Design[/b]
This week Luke has reworked the Sanctum, with a view to implementing a more comprehensive tutorial and new user experience. Once integrated new players will be learning about the game, and choosing their starting world in a slick and engaging way. He’s also worked out how creatures will choose targets based on a “threat” system.

Ollie has been generating lots of data for the attributes system, which covers player progression, creatures and how they are generated, and items and how they work with a character’s attributes.

Rob has been working on the final bits for the HUD, including what information is shown when looking at blocks and interactive entities. The per block HUD elements will help you understand: what is in a beacon, what is outside, what is locked, what will regen, and what it shared with other players. He’s also been working out the information that is shown about Warps and Portals. And finally working out the details of what is shown when looking up at a planet in the sky.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/b7acc9ef37f769e1066047189c33ba925b7ad247.png[/img]

[b]Art[/b]
This week the art team have been busy working on all aspects of improving our game visually. In particular we’ve been delving into concepting our characters and looking at the full breadth of customisation aspects that we’d like to see in the near future. Here’s a first glimpse of this working process where we eventually aim for you to be able to choose your face, skin and head shape in a fully interchangeable way.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/cae0c97b6347c264f65c43dd1981598209e634d4.jpg[/img]

The current flowers of boundless have also been getting a bit of polish and loving attention. We’ve increased the visual fidelity of the mesh to allow a more crafted and detailed end outcome. Here’s a few images of the stages of progress done under the hood, behind the scenes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/f5f0d3d42152bf56c7eef0b481e632a22a19e6ad.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/bf95b9dbb2cca9a572b38d6f50ecd873a620fd2e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/34428b3df0adcac2114e14ce44ee20d6840c4922.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/2d9ea82feae9e64e7915a809c1ed65744d87747e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/28638564b4d5eb5f4a4c53abf85de0baf56f0062.jpg[/img]

Finally we’ve also been ploughing on ahead with our Hunter with a series of patrolling and attacking animations. Tune in next week where we’ll be able to update the animation Hunter dev post with the full set of animations. Until then, Jess has created the Tier 3 model of the Hunter in aptly themed Valentine's day colours!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/674bb91e22a1a732801d9f673854ce25b9fe0b22.jpg[/img]


[i]Cross posted from [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/weekly-dev-update-2017-february-17th-portals-character-customisation-and-flowers/6468]devlog forum

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update: 2017 February 10th - Less suicidal Creatures, More devious Creatures!
notes.content:
This week we updated [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-155-more-hopper-and-road-runner/6337]Boundless for Release 155[/url]. This included further tweaks to the grapple, new Hopper features and the release of the Roadrunner.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/c5bbe0664765a26e2c854cf0bc2a651ae19b993d.jpg[/img]

We have been testing the PS4 version to make sure that it has parity for the PC version of Boundless.

We have continued work on the unified Attributes / Stats / Progression System, the user-created Portals and adding support for Location Markers on Planets in the HUD. These are all still in progress and will be available to play with as soon as possible.

The following items are candidates for release next week:
[list]
[*]GUI rendering, update and animation optimisations to increase game performance.
[*]Tweaks to the Player damage indicator in the HUD.
[*]Improved Creature AI, including creatures not falling off cliffs, avoiding obstacles and searching for routes to track you.
[/list]
If you're experiencing Latency issues with Boundless please try [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/q-how-do-you-configure-the-bandwidth-required-by-boundless/6182]reducing the Chunk Download Limit[/url]. If you still experience Latency then share a screenshot with the debugging information displayed (press "." to access it).

[b]Code[/b]
The latest update included the skittish Roadrunner and new physical interactions with the Hopper. Both creatures can be manipulated with the Grapple. We've also been working on improving the shared creature navigation so they can get around barriers, such as walls, and they have finally evolved enough self preservation to no longer jump off cliffs! Beware the Spitters will now be hunting you down more ruthlessly, even through simple mazes.

The HUD work continues adding more damage information, both receiving (direction and damage amount) and delivering to creatures. Additional information is being added when the Totem is used to show other locations you already already on a Planet.

The GUI speed improvement are now merged into Boundless for release and have reduced the cost, especially when opening the Inventory and physically animation (wobbling). Work has not commenced on reskinning the GUI with new textures for 1.0 release.

We been adding the unified Attribute System (was previous called Stats System) for more flavour and variation in Progression, Items, Tools, Weapons, Ammo, Brews, Bombs and Creatures.

For PlayStation 4 we’ve been working through some of the Technical Requirements Checklist that are required to pass submission for a release. We are also working on the backend of user management, making it more scalable and adding support for PS4 sign-in. Quite a bit of time was spent on bugs fixing, adding support for VFX and SFX hooks. Otherwise time was spent on more Maya modelling export work.

[b]Design[/b]
This week Rob has been working on how players view and interact with Objectives, as well as how the Rewards are presented in the GUI and HUD. He’s also been working on what information is shown on Planets in the Sky and how that information is displayed to players.

The following shows the process of creating a Warp to a new Location Marker.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/06a1a4a329f34aa3603ca6834e318b045ee630ee.gif[/img]

When holding the Totem the following Locations will be presented on a Planet in the HUD:
[list]
[*]All of your personal Location Markers.
[*]The locations of your friends Beacons.
[*]All of your Guilds shared Location Markers.
[*]The single most prestigious Capital Beacon.

We have been testing the PS4 version to make sure that it has parity for the PC version of Boundless.

We have continued work on the unified Attributes / Stats / Progression System, the user-created Portals and adding support for Location Markers on Planets in the HUD. These are all still in progress and will be available to play with as soon as possible.

The following items are candidates for release next week:
[list]
[*]GUI rendering, update and animation optimisations to increase game performance.
[*]Tweaks to the Player damage indicator in the HUD.
[*]Improved Creature AI, including creatures not falling off cliffs, avoiding obstacles and searching for routes to track you.

notes.title: Release 155: More Hopper and Road Runner!
notes.content:
[b]This update is accessible via the "Live" release of Boundless on Steam.[/b]

Please [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-155-report-issues-here/6336]report all issues discovered with the update to this support thread[/url].

Please restart Steam to make sure you get the latest version of Boundless. If the update happens whilst Steam is open it's unlikely you'll get the latest version.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/3739b69a15d3f637f03baf1590803e02d5bc6f3c.jpg[/img]

[b]Release Notes: 155[/b]
[list]
[*]Crafting + Resources + Equipment:
[list]
[*]First pass of grapple variations
[list]
[*]Different types of grapple have different maximum ranges and reel in/out speeds
[*]Some grapples are "hook-shots" (they will pull you in as soon as they connect, and won't stop until you hit the grappled target)
[*]Due to the speeds of the faster grapples, damage from impacts with the world is disabled whilst grappling. NOTE: This is a temporary work-around, not a feature!
[/list]
[*]New Objectives:
[list]
[*]Objectives have been added to explain how to build the furnace and workbench.
[*]Additional objectives have been added for collecting, mining, crafting and building.
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Creatures + Combat:
[list]
[*]Fixed beacon check for spawning creatures using incorrect Y value.
[*]New Hopper behaviour:
[list]
[*]When hit with enough damage the hopper will now go into a ball state.
In this state the hopper can be rolled around (pushed by players or pulled by grapple beams!).
[*]The hopper will now always explode if it is killed in the hostile state (so run away if you don't want an explosion).
[*]If you are quick you can scare the hopper into a ball before it becomes hostile.
[*]Hoppers now float in water.
[*]Fixed hoppers getting stuck trying to jump over 1 block high walls (they can now jump over 2 blocks easily every time).
[/list]
[*]Added a new creature "Road Runner":
[list]
[*]The road runner is a rare creature that doesn't like players.
[*]It is easily scared and will try and escape (very quickly) if threatened.
[*]Sneaking can be used (default key C) to get closer to them.
[/list]
[/list]
[*]GUI + HUD:
[list]
[*]Added new debug mode to show only the debug information without the HUD. (This mode can be activated using the '.' key)
[*]Updated player HUD damage indicators.
[/list]
[*]Server:
[list]
[*]Optimised the server damage system to reduce server CPU load.
[/list]
[*]Bug fixes:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where some players would end up stuck logged into a world after exiting the game.
[*]Fixed a case where planets would not be visible in the sky.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Outstanding Known Issues:[/b]

[i]The following items are known issues in this release.[/i]
[list]
[*]Buying plinths that had wanted items set before v151 have unset them. Sorry. Going forward they will be fine.
[*]Chat text overlaps with HUD Text in the centre of the screen.
[*]Entity rendering will not always work correctly when there are multiple warps very close together, or where a warp opens up to a location very near where the entrance is.
[*]Gem grappling hooks retract automatically when hanging.
[*][NEW] Opening or closing doors and trapdoors when standing too close to them will restrict player movement. To get out of the situation, interact with the door or trapdoor again.
[*]Shift-clicking an item from the selling plinth will show odd numbers and will not always go in the shopping basket.
[*]Shift-clicking and dragging on the coin icons from within the trading menus may cause a crash.
[*]Some Extractor machines lack animation.
[*]Some interactive blocks (crafting table, machine, beacon control) have become corrupted during the migration. This will result in at best those blocks not being able to be interacted with, at worst the game crashing when interacting with those blocks. To fix the issue the block(s) in question need to be re-placed. In the case of anything other than a beacon control the block can simply be broken, picked up, and then re-placed. In the case of a beacon control this will work, although it would result in all the plots having to be re-placed one at a time and during that process the contents being unprotected. A better workaround for a beacon control is to craft a new beacon control, place that, and then break the old one, which will keep the beacon's plots placed throughout the process.
[*]The recipes are not final.
[*]Z-fighting with some items (workbench and other machines) when placed underwater.
[/list]

[i]Cross posted from [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-155-more-hopper-and-road-runner/6337]devlog forum

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update: 2017 February 3rd - Rolling Hopper, Stats, and Elements!
notes.content:
This week we [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-154-compass-landmarks-and-warps-cost/6255]updated the game Release 154[/url] to add new features to the compass and [strike]break[/strike] improve the Warps. We have also fixed a wide range of bugs in the grapple hook. The general balance of the Grapple (and all Equipment) will continue to change up to 1.0. All the different material variations of each tool and weapon will offer different balanced values. More details can be found [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-154-compass-landmarks-and-warps-cost/6255]here[/url].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/d1e28794a448a8ffded9322fcbfd6d3af92332cd.jpg[/img]

For next week, we are targeting to update the game with the following:
[list]
[*]Update grapple hook control / balance.
[*]Tweaked tool animations.
[*]New Hopper animations (including explosion on death).
[*]Roadrunner in the game.
[*]More HUD features
[/list]
Bigger updates we are targeting for this month are the Portal creation and the foundation of a RPG system to allow us to build up and enhance our Player Stats and Player Progression.

[b]Code[/b]
The Hopper will now transition into a rolling state once shot that can be pushed or grappled around. This allows you to manipulate the Hopper into a helpful (or dangerous) explosive tool. The Hopper will also swim if dropped into water. (If you count bobbing around and kicking its little legs a bit as swimming.)

We’ve done some tweaks on the Grapple hook to improve the prediction and placements in the world. More updates are still to do.

We are working on a generic Stats System that will allow multiple modifiers to be applied to the Player, Items, Equipment and Creatures. This will be used with the Creature for the Elemental and Exotic enhancements, for levelling up Players, forging Tools and Weapons, and crafting temporary buffs.

The portal work continues. It's non-trivial because the player needs to define both source and target locations which are likely to be on different worlds, and the servers need to be synchronised with their creation, fuel costs, and expiration.

The HUD Compass polish up showing more information about your Beacons and Named World Regions. We continue to optimise the GUI and HUD update and rendering to not slow down the game as much, especially on devices with slower CPUs including the PS4 where it's very noticeable.

To enable the art team we have been doing some work on the Special Materials for [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/introducing-the-elements-of-boundless-updated/4366]advanced blocks[/url], items and equipment variations (for example an Oort Slingbow). We are also working on the Maya exporter pipeline to allow simpler model exports.

On the servers we’ve been addressing more issues with the database back end and continue the bot testing work.

[b]Design[/b]
Luke has been continuing to work on the Objectives, and the rewards they can give. He’s also been working with Andy on the stats system, and tweaking some things in the forum setup.

Rob has done a pass on the Guilds GUI, and he’s also worked out how the beginning flow of the game should work for new players. This includes stages such as: Account Creation or Sign In, selection an initial World spawn (near a friend, default selection, or custom selection) and, Character creation and customisation. Below is the part of the design:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/64abf86237ae41e35c216285ad45ca4c09007e8d.jpg[/img]

Ollie has managed to break out of Hansoft, and has done some polish and balancing work on the grapple. He’s also been supporting the work on the stats system, and helping out with the creature polish.

[b]Art[/b]
This week we’ve been doing planning and working across many of areas of the game.

We've experiment with creating some natural prefabs for the 1.0 biomes.

Amanda has [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/art-large-and-small-worm/6269]concepted the Large and Small worms[/url] and the bigger stages of the [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/art-block-parasite-concept-art/6183]Block Parasite[/url]. She’s now moving onto interior decorative props. We’ll share with you soon.

Jess has been working on creating the dynamic special materials. There’s still a bit more work to do before we can reveal these.

Dom has been continuing experimenting with the Elemental variations of the explosions. Below is the Corrosion version:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/8d253341eb006f9d3f1c2131c4997f1ed6e92db6.gif[/img]

Gerry has provided animation support for Fooks who’s integrated the Hopper rolling around and jumping to its feet.

We’ve also released better night time lighting. All gleam and lights will look more atmospheric at night… guaranteed!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/45e94c8341d4ddea865f8638f674ed8a9f90efd5.jpg[/img]

[i]Cross posted from [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/weekly-dev-update-2017-february-3rd-rolling-hopper-stats-and-elements/6290]devlog forum

notes.title: Release 154: Compass Landmarks and Warps Cost!
notes.content:
[b]This update is accessible via the "Live" release of Boundless on Steam.[/b]

Please [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-154-report-issues-here/6256]report all issues discovered with the update to this support thread[/url].

Please restart Steam to make sure you get the latest version of Boundless. If the update happens whilst Steam is open it's unlikely you'll get the latest version.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/dda054898f7af356f7281f58c1f4d4ac22c3ae0f.jpg[/img]

[b]Release Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Art + Animation + Assets:
[list]
[*]Added darker night time lighting.
[*]Removed greenish values from the night sky cubemap.
[/list]
[*]Crafting + Resources + Equipment:
[list]
[*]Added new restrictions to remove/place blocks to connected powercores.
[*]Fixed a crash caused by placing a machine next to pipes connecting multiple powercore groups.
[*]Fixed held torch and totem beam not playing audio.
[*]New grapple beam audio.
[/list]
[*]Creatures + Combat:
[list]
[*]Fix for creatures spawning on surfaces inside a beacon but with the block above not inside a beacon.
[/list]
[*]GUI + HUD:
[list]
[*] Added a new option to landmark saved locations. (The landmark locations will be displayed on the compass)
[*] Added compass location text to display the player's world and closest region.
[*] Updated compass information when a player is inside a beacon.
[*]Updated GUI glyph colours to represent the relationship with the player.
[/list]
[*]Warps + Portals:
[list]
[*]Locations in the warp conduit screen now display current/required coin and conduit block counts to activate the warp to the given location similar to crafting interfaces.
[*]Locations in your inventory now display their distance based on the world you're currently on.
[*]Trying to activate a warp that will leave you without enough coins to return will pop up a dialog to confirm the action.
[*]Warps now have a requirement on the size of the warp depending on the distance travelled. Travelling further requires a physically larger warp. This does not apply to the Sanctum.
[*]Warps now have costs determined by the distance travelled in the universe, calculated by the number of hops in the world graph.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Resolved Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Chat UI overlaps with Game Log UI.
[*]Grappling hooks will occasionally be left on the ground.
[*]Grappling hooks will occasionally go through blocks.
[*]Occasional crash may occur when using grappling hook.
[/list]
[b]Outstanding Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Buying plinths that had wanted items set before v151 have unset them. Sorry. Going forward they will be fine.
[*]Chat text overlaps with HUD Text in the centre of the screen.
[*]Entity rendering will not always work correctly when there are multiple warps very close together, or where a warp opens up to a location very near where the entrance is.
[*]Gem grappling hooks retract automatically when hanging.
[*]Shift-clicking an item from the selling plinth will show odd numbers and will not always go in the shopping basket.
[*]Shift-clicking and dragging on the coin icons from within the trading menus may cause a crash.
[*]Some Extractor machines lack animation.
[*]Some interactive blocks (crafting table, machine, beacon control) have become corrupted during the migration. This will result in at best those blocks not being able to be interacted with, at worst the game crashing when interacting with those blocks. To fix the issue the block(s) in question need to be re-placed. In the case of anything other than a beacon control the block can simply be broken, picked up, and then re-placed. In the case of a beacon control this will work, although it would result in all the plots having to be re-placed one at a time and during that process the contents being unprotected. A better workaround for a beacon control is to craft a new beacon control, place that, and then break the old one, which will keep the beacon's plots placed throughout the process.
[*]The recipes are not final.
[*]Z-fighting with some items (workbench and other machines) when placed underwater.
[/list]
[b]Release: 154.1[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issue with the calculation of Warps between worlds.
[*]Reduced Warp costs to be consistent with the player progression currently in game.
[/list]
[i]Cross posted from [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-154-compass-landmarks-and-warps-cost/6255]devlog forum

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update: 2017 January 27th: More Warps, More Grapples!
notes.content:
This week we released [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/testing-32-intra-world-warps-and-grapples/6166]Testing 32[/url] and then [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-153-intra-world-warps-and-grapples/6170]Live Release 153[/url]. These contain a small collection of features, most significantly support for intra-world warping. You can now easily go home after a long journey in the same world but at a financial cost. The releases also contained updates to the network libraries and made some changes to [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/latency-issue-update/5905]tackle the lagging issue[/url]. Please try setting the latency limit and letting us know how this performs for you. There are more [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/q-how-do-you-configure-the-bandwidth-required-by-boundless/6182]details about the bandwidth requirements in this FAQ entry[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/74f839af64cb403a70c374cc406c9f80af2d8910.jpg[/img]

Next week, we are targeting to update the game with the following:
[list]
[*]Further tweaks and bug fixes to the grapple.
[*]Location markers and HUD navigation so that you can easily mark places visited whilst travelling
[*]Further visual / usability improvements to the compass.
[*]Tweaked 3rd person tool/weapon animations.
[*]Additional features added to warps.
[/list]
Next month, you'll start to see the following:
[list]
[*]Start of 1.0 GUI skinning.
[*]Player progression improvements.
[*]Roadrunners in the game.
[*]Improved creature combat, AI and animation.
[*]Portal crafting.
[/list]
[b]Code[/b]
This week we’ve updated the game to v153. There is still some work ongoing on the Grapple to fix issues, such as it not always attaching when it impacts and improving the prediction logic.

The HUD has had the Landmark feature added, to allow you to select a Location to go to and then see the marker on the Compass and in world when near by. We continue to optimise the GUI and HUD to remove the choppiness when it changes.

The Warps and Portal dynamic costs have been updated so it will depend on the number of planet hops involved. The player-created Portal work is in progress.

In the back end we’ve update the network libraries and reworked how it is polled to help address some of the lag issues people are experiencing. We’ve also continued work on bot testing for server stress testing and the database deployment.

[b]Design[/b]
This week Ollie has been mainly working on planning out the future large milestones for Boundless (using his favourite piece of software: Hansoft). He has also started some work on balancing the grapples, although that hasn’t made it into the game yet.

Rob has been carrying on with work on the Guilds screens, and started on the intro flow to the game.

Luke has been focused on the beginning of the game, as well as the objectives and how they affect progression.

[b]Art[/b]
The art team has been busy supporting this week’s release with the new grapple and VFX.

Creature concepting has continued with the giant worm’s larval stage: [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/art-block-parasite-concept-art/6183]the dreaded Block Parasite[/url].

Dom’s been working on a scalable explosion system. Here’s his exploding ice shard test for the Chill elemental effect. This is black and white but will be coloured blue:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/05be69891ea30ce5d5e47030f8ce1033f4663be2.gif[/img]

Jess has completed Hunter tier 2. Here’s a WIP image. You can see the bigger head and the beginning spread of armour down the arms and tail.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/a4425a572f16a5e42c6e37586807e7191d2745a5.jpg[/img]

She also made a new shard base item. They will be used as part of the Portal system.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/6ad1e8c6e3cc989621ed6d75851d67445e8ed14d.jpg[/img]

[i]Cross posted from [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/weekly-dev-update-2017-january-27th-more-warps-more-grapples/6216]devlog forum

notes.title: Release 153: Intra World Warps and Grapples!
notes.content:
[b]This update is accessible via the "Live" release of Boundless on Steam.[/b]

Please [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-153-report-issues-here/6171]report all issues discovered with the update to this support thread[/url].

Please restart Steam to make sure you get the latest version of Boundless. If the update happens whilst Steam is open it's unlikely you'll get the latest version.

Overview:

This Live release publishes [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/testing-31-bandwidth-limiting-and-monitoring/6115]Testing 31[/url] and [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/testing-32-intra-world-warps-and-grapples/6166]Testing 32[/url] to Live.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/c277fc77a306af2daeff792e1b1871cedba7f649.jpg[/img]

[b]Release Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Crafting + Resources + Equipment:
[list]
[*]Grapple
[list]
[*]Grapple beam effects.
[*]New controls. Grapples can be independently controlled with the left and right trigger/bumper buttons (+ d-pad down to release the oldest grapple) on a pad, and pulled/relaxed with 'r' and 'f' respectively on a keyboard.
[*]The majority of grapples no longer jerk you towards a grappled block when they connect.
[*]Change view button moved from 'r' to 'v' on keyboard.
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Creatures + Combat:
[list]
[*]Fix creatures spawning inside player beacons.
[*]The Tier 3 Spitter has an updated mesh and textures in line with other new creatures, supporting tinting and decals.
[/list]
[*]GUI + HUD:
[list]
[*]Added animations in the combat and chat log.
[*]Added new gain HUD log.
[*]Added passive and aggressive enemies in the compass.
[*]Compass reskin using new assets.
[/list]
[*]Warps + Portals:
[list]
[*]Can now open warps to locations on the same world, these warps have a still temporary, but lower price of 300 compared to the usual cost of 500 coins.
[*]Unbroken, activated warps will now convert after 1 minute to a dormant warp state instead of automatically opening, wherein they may be re-activated for free to the same destination.
[/list]
[*]Engine:
[list]
[*]Added monitoring of chunk download bandwidth on the debug screen and implemented rate limiting (setting in the options menu) of the chunk downloads to try and help with lag issues.
[*]Chunk downloading rate correctly saved in the game options.
[*]Expose send error reasons so we can kick people when sends are failing.
[*]Track error states on the protocol and kick players with protocol errors.
[*]Unload chunks over multiple frames to make portal transitions smoother.
[*]Update client and server networking libraries to latest versions.
[*]Update server connection processing to better resist players with slow connections hurting performance.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Outstanding Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Buying plinths that had wanted items set before v151 have unset them. Sorry. Going forward they will be fine.
[*]Chat text overlaps with HUD Text in the centre of the screen.
[*]Chat UI overlaps with Game Log UI.
[*]Entity rendering will not always work correctly when there are multiple warps very close together, or where a warp opens up to a location very near to where the entrance is.
[*]Gem grappling hooks retract automatically when hanging.
[*]Grappling hooks will occasionally be left on the ground.
[*]Grappling hooks will occasionally go through blocks.
[*]Occasional crash may occur when using grappling hook.
[*]Shift-clicking an item from the selling plinth will show odd numbers and will not always go in the shopping basket.
[*]Shift-clicking and dragging on the coin icons from within the trading menus may cause a crash.
[*]Some Extractor machines lack animation.
[*]Some interactive blocks (crafting table, machine, beacon control) have become corrupted during the migration. This will result in at best those blocks not being able to be interacted with, at worst the game crashing when interacting with those blocks. To fix the issue the block(s) in question need to be re-placed. In the case of anything other than a beacon control the block can simply be broken, picked up, and then re-placed. In the case of a beacon control this will work, although it would result in all the plots having to be re-placed one at a time and during that process the contents being unprotected. A better workaround for a beacon control is to craft a new beacon control, place that, and then break the old one, which will keep the beacon's plots placed throughout the process.
[*]The recipes are not final.
[*]Z-fighting with some items (workbench and other machines) when placed underwater.
[/list]

[i]Cross posted from devlog forum which can be found [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-153-intra-world-warps-and-grapples/6170] here

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update: 2017 January 20th: Seams, Intra-world Warps, and shhh Portals!
notes.content:
This week we updated the game with various improvements including the [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-152-wip-grapple-metal-seams-and-more/6093]new WIP grapple system[/url] in Release 152. We also released a Testing version to Steam that [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/testing-31-bandwidth-limiting-and-monitoring/6115]supports download bandwidth limiting[/url] in Testing 32. The download bandwidth is displayed in the debugging info and can be limited in the main game options. The aim of this Testing update was to rate limit the chunk downloading to try and help with lag issues experienced by some players. There are [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/latency-issue-update/5905]more details about our work to improve the latency issues in this devlog[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/dfe429a3603e28f1e6c85ff062a0f652d387dfff.jpg[/img]

In the next release we plan to:
[list]
[*]Update the grapple system with more improvements including replacing the debug line with a proper VFX.
[*]Release improved portal / warp transition for slower computers.
[*]Release a HUD update for Game, Combat and Chat logs.
[*]Make visual improvements on the Compass and add more features.
[*]Add support for Location Markers.
[*]Release the remaining Machine animation when active.
[*]Release Warping within the same world! So now you can Warp home if you're lost. Yeah!
[/list]
Beyond these items we're working on: skinning the GUI, improved progression, improved creature combat, creature AI and creature animation.

notes.title: Release 152: WIP Grapple, Metal Seams and more!
notes.content:
[b]This update is accessible via the "Live" release of Boundless on Steam.[/b]

Please [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-152-report-issues-here/6094]report all issues discovered with the update to this support thread[/url].

Please restart Steam to make sure you get the latest version of Boundless. If the update happens whilst Steam is open it's unlikely you'll get the latest version.

[b]Overview:[/b]

Minor update to introduce changes to the chisel, spanners and dual grapples.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/067d2efe11a72dff4932d506afffbcca3eae0277.jpg[/img]

[b]Release Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Art + Animation + Assets:
[list]
[*]Metal ore seams now have new unique textures to aid recognition.
[/list]
[*]Crafting + Resources + Equipment:
[list]
[*]Fix players being able to rotate blocks in other players' beacons.
[*]Spanners have new models in line with the design of other tools and weapons.
[*]The chisel tool can now rotate prop blocks (crafting table, crucible, machines, storage, shelves and plinths).
[*]WIP (work in progress) dual handed grapple update.
[/list]
[*]GUI + HUD:
[list]
[*]Fixing bug on smart stacking items.
[/list]
[*]SFX + Music:
[list]
[*]New sound effects for:
[list]
[*]light cube shake.
[*]totem pick location.
[*]add and remove beacon plots.
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Server:
[list]
[*]Added more debugging tools for server crashes.
[/list]
[*]Grapple system updated.
[list]
[*]Grapple hooks detach when released and fired as a projectile (so there's no longer an instant hit!). The grapple does not become active until the hook has embedded into a target point, creature, or player.
[*]Grapple connector rope rendered as a debug line, with a proper connector visualisation to follow.
[*]Character animation updated to handle grapples in either hand. Some glitching occurs while grappling, but this will be fixed shortly.
[*]MISSING: Grappling controls are due to be reworked.
[/list]
[/list]

[i]Cross posted from devlog forum which can be found [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-152-wip-grapple-metal-seams-and-more/6093] here

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update: 2017 January 13th: Grapple and Fixes
notes.content:
This week we updated the Live release in Steam with the contents from [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/testing-30-smart-stacking-2-0-and-combat-log/5925]Testing 30[/url] as [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-151-smart-stacks-and-fixes/6000]Release 151[/url]. The major change in these updates is a refactoring of the Smart Stacking system to improve the stability on the server and clients. Thank you to the players who took the time to send us bug reports. There are still a few outstanding issues which we will resolve this coming week.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/6b56e94cf1880e8a371811e29414f002bf51ad6d.jpg[/img]
Next week, we are targeting to release the following:
[list]
[*]Updated Grapple hook system including new 3rd person animations
[*]Improved Game, Combat and Chart logs in the HUD.
[*]Rotate Machines and Storage to change the direction they face using a chisel.
[/list]
As stated in [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/weekly-dev-update-2017-january-6th-fixes-testing-30-and-more/5941]last week’s Weekly Dev Update[/url] there are many improvements and new features we're working on in parallel and coming this month.

We've also done a round of PS4 and PC consistency testing to make sure there is feature parity. Currently all the features in the PC version are working in the PS4 version at Boundless HQ.

[b]Code[/b]
This week we’ve continued to work on issues users have been experiencing, especially around Inventory and Smart Stacks. Two updates were released containing these fixes.

We continue to look into the network lag issues, running some experiments and updating the network libraries that we use to their latest versions. Details of our [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/latency-issue-update/5905]progress have been shared in this post[/url] - please track this if you experience significant latency.

We've also been working on the following:
[list]
[*]The Grapple Hook works now as much of the functionally and animations in with some work remaining on controls and the effects.
[*]Some additional sound effects have been added for beacon plots and the light cube.
[*]The HUD work has added more to the combat logs.
[*]The chisel is now super powered with the ability to rotate any orientable mesh blocks.
[*]The intra-planet warps refactoring is underway. This will allow Warps and Portals to work within the same world.
[*]Engine side we’ve been working on some loaded testing with bots to help stress test the servers.
[/list]
[b]Design[/b]
This week has been quite bitty as we’re working on improving stability, choosing the direction for the next major release, and understanding how best we can get more people to know about Boundless.

Ollie has been planning and documenting the next steps for the project, as well as supporting Rob in his UX work. He’s also been supporting work on creature generation, the stats system and the grapple.

Rob has been working on the UX and GUI design for Portals and Warps, Friends, and Locations and Worlds.

Luke has continued his work on the Steam store page and publicising the game generally. This includes looking at other games and how they represent themselves on Steam. As part of that he’s been writing a feature list to better communicate what features we have now, and what we intend to implement in the future. With his remaining time he’s been continuing with work on the stats system.

[b]Art + Animation[/b]
This week the art team has been busy working on items, creatures and the grapple.
[list]
[*]Items - we have a new ingot asset for metal alloys. This should be available in the latest release.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/2f86b2a0fa68a94ef633e5fca0f76c22c1a313d2.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Creatures - Amanda has been looking at how we will convert the giant worm to 3D. Below is a sheet with construction details:
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/240b2fbbf479b6f3ab7ab78334142d6360f9a18c.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Creatures - Jess is modelling the Hunter and done a first pass on the hunter trails. This is still WIP and it takes time to get things looking really slick:
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/8b808980d3dde90a1d3fc63773e73ff25a302fc4.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Grapple - Here’s Dom’s WIP VFX for the grapple line:
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/6aefeaf7c0104a355c46392895a7ffd7d4934226.gif[/img]

Gerry has been working on an improved grapple animation set which is a big improvement to what we had previously. These anims together with the new grapple functionality should be available soon.

[i]Cross posted from devlog forum which can be found [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/weekly-dev-update-2017-january-13th-grapple-and-fixes/6044] here

notes.title: Release 151: Smart Stacks and Fixes
notes.content:
[b]This update is accessible via the "Live" release of Boundless on Steam[/b].

Please [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-151-report-issues-here/6001]report all issues discovered with the update to this support thread[/url].

Please restart Steam to make sure you get the latest version of Boundless. If the update happens whilst Steam is open it's unlikely you'll get the latest version.

[b]Overview:[/b]

This Live release contains the features from [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/testing-30-smart-stacking-2-0-and-combat-log/5925]Testing 30[/url] and some additional fixes.

The most significant update is a refactored Smart Stacking system. Hopefully this will be much more solid and greatly reduce the number of client and server crashes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/3828021d889636ead1f7a2be02e3d032eeee23a6.jpg[/img]

[b]Important: [/b]

If you experience any ongoing networking or latency issues then please [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/latency-issue-update/5905]track this thread[/url]. We're continuing to investigate and work on resolutions to the issue.

[b]Release Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Art + Animation + Assets:
[list]
[*]Added machine animations for workbench, workbench rotator, workbench input, refinery rotator, extractor rotator and extractor input.
[*]Fixed black plants on some worlds.
[*]Fixed ink, fibre and cloth not inheriting colours from ingredients.
[*]Fixed some prop blocks appearing inside the floor when placed on a slope.
[*]Locks no longer flip upside-down at a distance.
[*]Metal alloys created by crafting now have an asset instead of a placeholder cube.
[/list]
[*]Creatures + Combat:
[list]
[*]Arrows and tools no longer hit dead creatures.
[*]Fixed a bug where chasing wildstock can't climb up 1 high blocks.
[*]Fixed server crash when a cuttletrunk follows a target for a long time.
[*]Point planets now displayed as stars.
[/list]
[*]GUI + HUD:
[list]
[*]Added combat log first state.
[*]Fixed an issue where it was possible to select planets through solid geometry including distant mountains.
[*]Inventory tooltips now give a preview of what action will occur between the held item and the hovered item.
[*]Refactored inventory API and Smart Stacking code to make it less fragile for fixes and additions.
[*]Support for using Smart Stacks in plinths, machines and furnaces.
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Resolved Known Issues:[/b]

[list]
[*]Buying plinth not displaying items on top.
[*]Cannot smart stack walls.
[*]Some of the items were not positioned in the hand correctly when the players are seen in 3rd person view.
[*]Some of the items displayed in the inventory screen were not positioned correctly.
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]

[i]The following items are known issues in this release.[/i]
[list]
[*]Shift-clicking an item from the selling plinth will show odd numbers and will not always go in the shopping basket.
[*]Shift-clicking and dragging on the coin icons from within the trading menus may cause a crash.
[*]Some interactive blocks (crafting table, machine, beacon control) have become corrupted during the migration. This will result in at best those blocks not being able to be interacted with, at worst the game crashing when interacting with those blocks. To fix the issue the block(s) in question need to be re-placed. In the case of anything other than a beacon control the block can simply be broken, picked up, and then re-placed. In the case of a beacon control this will work, although it would result in all the plots having to be re-placed one at a time and during that process the contents being unprotected. A better workaround for a beacon control is to craft a new beacon control, place that, and then break the old one, which will keep the beacon's plots placed throughout the process.
[*]The recipes are not final.
[*]Z-fighting with some items (workbench and other machines) when placed underwater.
[/list]

[i]Cross posted from devlog forum which can be found [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-151-smart-stacks-and-fixes/6000] here

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update: 2017 January 6th: Fixes, Testing 30, and more!
notes.content:
Happy Perihelion everyone!!

And welcome to the first Weekly Dev Update of 2017. This will be the year that Boundless hits 1.0. Thank you to everyone who has supported the game so far, and we're excited to see how the game and community can grow this year.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/7e14c2e0de274fc3ab5d5fc89ddc67ee20504fe8.jpg[/img]

This week, we have been busy fixing issues reported over the Christmas and New Year break. We have updated the game twice with [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-150-fixes-pre-fixes-logging-and-not-much-more-yet/5891]150 and 150.1[/url], addressing some critical issues. We are also looking into the lag issue that is making the game unplayable at times for some players. We have also released [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/testing-30-smart-stacking-2-0-and-combat-log/5925]Testing 30[/url] that mainly contains a refactoring of the Smart Stacking system. Assuming this doesn't devour everyone's inventories it will be deployed to Live next week.

Here is a list of work we are looking into completing or starting this month:
[list]
[*]HUD + GUI:
[list]
[*]Release overhauled Smart Stacking + Inventory system to address the numerous smart stacking issues.
[*]Complete the HUD visual overhaul (improved compass, improve chat, add combat log, ...)
[*]Start reskinning all the other GUI such as storage and crafting GUI to match the HUD design.
[*]Finalise the GUI design for the Character Select, Player Info, Guild Control, etc.
[/list]
[*]Assets:
[list]
[*]Complete Machine animation.
[*]Implement the updated Grapple + Hookshot to function properly.
[*]Create more decorative and functional props.
[*]Integrate all outstanding SFXs into the game.
[/list]
[*]Creatures:
[list]
[*]Add more animations for the Hopper and improve the Hopper AI
[*]More sophisticated creature generation and spawning. Adding support for the creature tints, decals and elementals.
[*]Complete more Hunter variant meshes.
[*]Release the Roadrunner into the wild.
[*]Complete a total of 15 creatures concepts sheets.
[/list]
[*]Engine:
[list]
[*]Finalise, migrate and deploy the Servers to a local database system for all world data and entities to make them more efficiency.
[*]Implement an initial caching system for World Chunks to greatly reduce bandwidth when restarting the game.
[*]Add support for Warping within a world.
[*]Complete and release user crafted Portals.
[/list]
[*]Make improvements to the Player Stats + Attributes system.
[*]Invite Trailblazers to play Boundless in Early Access.
[/list]
We will also be addressing issues and ideas contributed to the “[url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/planning-for-2017-contribute-your-ideas/5845]Planning for 2017 - Contribute your ideas![/url]” Thank you to everyone who took the time to contribute.

[b]Code[/b]
This week we have been investigating and fixing up bugs that have shown up in the latest versions and pushed out two updates to address some of the issues. We continue to look at the remaining issues including the rubber banding and slow network messages some people experience.

The grapple hook is being worked on to add the full behaviour, animation and fx. We have hooked in additional animations for machines when they are active.

The HUD has a new combat log on the right for damage related messages. We’ve been doing the last of the changes before the smart stacking and inventory rework in merged in.

Additionally we are working to get the database update integrated into the main line.

[b]Design[/b]
This week has been about recovering from the long and strenuous Christmas break where too much was eaten, and too much was drunk. Now we’re all back in the office we can relax into the comfortable rhythms of work.

Luke has been focused on two areas: the stats system, and our Steam store page.
[list]
[*]The stats system is a core foundation of many of the RPG elements of the game (combat, progression, creatures etc). We’re preparing for implementation of this system, which will enable us to build all the brilliant gameplay on top of it. At this stage it’s less about the exact details of the gameplay, and more about the constraints of the system.
[*]Our Steam store page is currently pretty sparse and is covered in caveats because we didn’t want people to buy the game unless they were fully prepared for its early state. As more gameplay is added to Boundless, we want to start to push the game more and raise the number of people playing. Updating our Steam store page is one part of that.
[/list]
Rob has been writing up a very comprehensive spec for the final iteration of the inventory system which covers any functionality around moving items between slots in the game, which is most of the GUI. We’re now ready to implement this, although it’s a fair amount of work to get it all done.

Ollie has been wrapping up a few bits and pieces of design, as well as helping to plan the next few weeks of work. The design areas touched on are: the grapple, the creature generation system, portals and warps, and impact VFX.

[b]Art[/b]
The art team has been a bit light this week with people coming back in dribs and drabs from the festive season.
We’re all refreshed though after the break and have made progress in these areas that you can see in the next release.

Pipes of power - Jess has put the final pipe junction asset in place and added an emissive pulsing animation shader to the pipes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/e695e7bba8da58a30549c7be7276d241cf1b4d2a.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/0c24fb9a2865dfb226767a932a503c0a8d35f4de.jpg[/img]

Juice! - Jess has also made some transparency fixes to the liquid bottle assets.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/06dbf3ad45368b996e78d26c071bb050ae8d62f1.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/f262ffc5d4901fb7808749c8a2f5ba905e87d92b.jpg[/img]

We’ve also added several machine animations for the workbench, refinery and extractor that will be available in the next release. We’ll be completing the full set of animations over the next few weeks.

Animation (Gerry) and VFX (Dom) are supporting grapple functionality development.

[i]Cross posted from devlog forum which can be found [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/weekly-dev-update-2017-january-6th-fixes-testing-30-and-more/5941] here

notes.title: Weekly Dev Update: 2016 December 23rd: Fixes, Live Update and more fixes!
notes.content:
This week we've been working on fixing the issues discovered in the Testing and Live releases. The team has been steadily departing for their Christmas holidays, gradually leaving less and less devs to help haul the game over the Live release line. But we finally [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/release-149-sanctum-creatures-and-more/5731]made the release - all the details are here[/url].

(Note to self: never attempt a game update in the last weeks before Christmas!)

Quite a short devlog entry this week as everyone was focused on getting the release done.

The entire team is on holiday between Christmas and New Year.

[b]Code[/b]
Fixing issues reported by players in the Testing and Live releases.

[b]Design[/b]
This week has been about getting the release onto the Live branch, with everyone helping out testing and fixing. We’ve been on a bit of a skeleton crew, but we’ve managed to get it done. Rob and Ollie have also updated the artwork on Steam, and planned out the GUI work that needs to be done next year.

[b]Art[/b]
This week the art team has been supporting the Live release.

Even with a reduced complement for the Christmas break we’ve also been able to produce these goodies for you:
[list]
[*]Wildstock production has continued producing tier 2 models. A touch up for the original Wildstock in game.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/db395ab610149a9cf6fe6e113e21d14b84545690.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Exploring elemental effects.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/873d777d8bc354d90a953ea28845292a8d709584.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]We’re close to wrapping up the worms progression concept sheet.
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7140575/c0c5959378fdca805d40d8da2e2ee1e214db2d42.jpg[/img]

Looking forward to sharing it with you in the New Year when we will also begin prototyping this exciting new addition to the Boundless universe.

[i]Cross posted from devlog forum which can be found [url=https://forum.playboundless.com/t/weekly-dev-update-2016-december-23rd-fixes-live-update-and-more-fixes/5786] here
